senses.gloss:
इयक्ष् इयक्ष् (Anomalous Desid. of rt. यज्),
Ved. occurring only in the part. pres. इयक्षत् and
इयक्षमाण, and in impf. subj. इयक्षान्, to go
towards, approach; to request, endeavour to gain; to
long for, seek.
इयक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. longing for, seeking to gain.

इयत् इयत्, आन्, अती, अत् (fr. pronominal base
3. इ), so large, only so large; so much, only so
much; [with इयत् cf. the syllable iens or ies in such
Lat. words as totiens, toties, quotiens, quoties, and
in numeral adverbs as quinquies.]
—इयत्-ता, f. or
इयत्-त्व, अम्, n. quantity, fixed measure or quantity,
so much.

इयत्तक, अस्, इका, अम्, Ved. so small, very small,
wee.

इयस्य इयस्य (Anomalous Intens. of rt.
यस्), A., Ved. इयस्यते, to relax, weaken; to vanish.
इयसा, f., Ved. lassitude, dejection, low spirits.
